AMAT · AMAT-2026-10-18-v3

July 26, 2026 TTM, forecast and capital origin; research information through October 18, 2026. This retrospective scenario is not an as-known-at-origin backtest or a current stock valuation. Current-price comparison is blocked.

Applied Materials: semiconductor systems, recurring services and other revenue are modeled separately. Base, downcycle and upside are complete, unweighted analyst scenarios, not management forecasts or probability bounds.

The July-origin first year combines 10,250 million Q4 guidance with 75% of modeled FY2027 revenue; subsequent rolling years use 25%/75% fiscal-year blends. The quarter allocation is an explicit timing assumption. October 13 management targets inform, but do not determine, the longer-run segment paths.

Base economic margin starts at 33%, reaches 35.5% and fades to 31%. It already includes future-grant compensation of 4% of revenue near term, fading to 2.5%. Other operating costs are a residual including D&A and expensed R&D. The 1,200 million legacy expense is subtracted and reversed identically, creating no valuation uplift.

Initial sales/capital of 2× is anchored to the 1.90× five-year cash-reinvestment diagnostic. Forecast investment uses the larger of growth funding and a capex/working-capital floor; incremental operating capital includes 21% working capital plus 2% cash. R&D and operating rent remain expenses. Existing tax-credit collections enter the capital bridge once.

Initial WACC is 10.9624454%, fading to 9.1657545%. USD risk-free, sector beta and equity-risk-premium observations have their own dates; target leverage and issuer spread are assumptions. October rates are used in a July-origin retrospective scenario, with no market-price fitting.

The near-term 13% planning rate moves toward a mature 23% base rate. Opening tax claims are deducted separately, and their settlement is excluded from forward operating taxes. The unusual FY2025 tax rate is not perpetuated.

Base terminal assumptions are 3% nominal growth, 31% economic margin, 23% tax, 20% ROIC and 9.1657545% WACC. Ongoing compensation and investment remain included. Terminal investment is NOPAT × growth / ROIC, with the same-year sales/capital timing adjustment preserved.

July common shares are 793.597443 million. The selected 8.7 million old-award addition is an estimated maximum-performance proxy, not a reported exact diluted count. Existing ESPP rights use a 110 million analyst claim, with 0–225 million sensitivity. No extra weighted EPS dilution, future-award dilution or legacy compensation PV asset is added.

Cash reserve, investment liquidation tax, private recovery and tax-credit collection are assumptions. A 0–41 million capital-credit/prepaid-tax overlap correction removes one discounted duplicate asset. Accrued financing interest is not fully mapped and is not asserted zero. Operating leases stay expensed; restricted compensation cash and liabilities remain paired.

No probability calibration is supplied. All simulation inputs start fixed at the selected case and Run is manual. The three scenarios and capital stresses have no assigned probabilities. Three recent upcycle guidance observations do not establish long-run forecasting reliability.

Ten fiscal years use normalized-capital-v2, with selected statement provenance and explicit missing values. FY2025 current debt includes 100 million commercial paper; an old zero current-maturities tag is not total current debt. R&D-capitalized diagnostics remain separate from the selected expense-based model. Full historical filings and conference audio were not reviewed end to end.

AMAT · AMAT-2026-10-18-v3

TTM、预测及资本基准日为 2026 年 7 月 26 日，研究信息截至 2026 年 10 月 18 日。这是回溯情景，不是基准日当时已知信息回测，也不是当前股价估值。当前价格比较已禁用。

应用材料：半导体系统、经常性服务及其他收入分别建模。基准、下行周期及上行情景均为完整且未赋权的分析假设，不是管理层预测或概率边界。

七月基准日之后的首年由 102.5 亿美元第四季度指引加上所建模 2027 财年收入的 75% 组成；后续滚动年度按相邻财年的 25%／75% 混合。季度分配是明确的时间假设。10 月 13 日管理层目标为长期分部路径提供参考，并不决定模型结果。

基准经济营业利润率从 33% 起步，达到 35.5% 后递减至 31%，已包含近期占收入 4%、成熟期降至 2.5% 的未来授予薪酬成本。其他经营成本为包含折旧摊销及费用化研发的残差。12 亿美元旧奖励费用等额扣除并转回，不提高估值。

初期销售／资本比 2 倍参考五年现金再投资诊断值 1.90 倍。预测投资取增长融资需求及资本开支／营运资本下限中的较大值；增量经营资本包括 21% 营运资本及 2% 现金。研发及经营租金继续费用化。现有税收抵免回收仅在资本桥接中计入一次。

初期 WACC 为 10.9624454%，递减至 9.1657545%。美元无风险利率、行业贝塔及股权风险溢价参考各有观察日期；目标杠杆及发行人利差属于假设。十月利率用于七月基准日的回溯情景，未拟合市场价格。

近期 13% 规划税率逐步过渡至基准成熟期税率 23%。期初税款请求权单独扣除，其结算不再计入未来经营税款。不将异常的 2025 财年税率永久化。

基准终值假设为 3% 名义增长率、31% 经济利润率、23% 税率、20% ROIC 及 9.1657545% WACC，仍包含持续薪酬及投资。终值再投资＝NOPAT×增长率／ROIC，并保留同期销售／资本比的时间调整。

七月普通股为 7.93597443 亿股。选定增加的 870 万旧奖励股数是最高绩效假设代理值，并非已报告的精确摊薄股数。现有 ESPP 权利采用 1.1 亿美元分析估计请求权，敏感性范围为 0–2.25 亿美元。不再增加加权 EPS 稀释、未来奖励稀释或旧薪酬费用现值资产。

现金储备、投资变现税、私募投资回收及税收抵免回收均属假设。0–4,100 万美元资本抵免／预付税款重叠调整仅移除一份折现后的重复资产。应计融资利息尚未完整归类，并非认定为零。经营租赁继续费用化；受限薪酬现金及负债保持配对。

未提供概率校准。全部模拟输入从固定选定情景开始，须手动运行。三个情景及资本压力测试均未赋予概率。近期上行周期的三次指引观察不能证明长期预测可靠性。

十个财年采用 normalized-capital-v2，保留所选报表来源及明确缺失值。2025 财年流动债务包含 1 亿美元商业票据；旧的长期债务当期到期额零值并非全部流动债务。研发资本化诊断与选定费用化模型分开。未逐页审核所有历史申报文件或完整收听会议音频。
